description: This Java source file defines the RetrieveResourceStrategy class, which handles the retrieval of resources in a policy management context within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It implements logic to process RetrieveResource commands, check for the existence of relevant policy entries and resources, and produce corresponding results.

classes.name: RetrieveResourceStrategy
classes.description: A final class that extends AbstractPolicyQueryCommandStrategy to handle RetrieveResource commands, providing logic to retrieve resources associated with policies and generate appropriate results.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the core logic of the strategy when a RetrieveResource command is received, checking for the associated policy entry and resource, and returning a successful result or appropriate error if not found.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Computes the next entity tag for the resource specified in the command, based on the new policy entity if provided.
